parameters.help_en:
Valid values for high-performance storage type:
ESSDPL0
ESSDPL1

city_redundancy (zone-redundant)

高性能存储类型取值如下：
ESSDPL0
ESSDPL1

冷存版存储类型取值如下：

local_redundancy (本地冗余)

MySQL
PostgreSQL
parameters.help_zh:
所属数据库生态，取值范围如下：
MySQL
PostgreSQL
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_zh: 专有网络ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_zh: 虚拟交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID
parameters.help_zh: 可用区id
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_zh: 存储空间，单位 GB
parameters.name: storage_space

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values: 

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值范围如下： 

Postpaid：按量付费
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is required when PayType is set to Prepaid. Specifies whether the subscription cluster uses a yearly or monthly billing cycle. You must pass this parameter when the billing method is subscription. 

Year: The subscription period is measured in years.
Month: The subscription period is measured in months
parameters.help_zh:
若付费类型为Prepaid时，该参数为必传参数。指定预付费集群为包年或包月类型。 

Year：包年。即选择包年包月时，单位为年。
Month：包月。即选择包年包月时，单位为月
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is required when PayType is set to Prepaid.
When Period is set to Month, the valid values of UsedTime are integers in the range of `[1-9]`.
When Period is set to Year, the valid values of UsedTime are integers in the range of `[1-3]`
parameters.help_zh:
若付费类型为Prepaid时，该参数为必传参数。
当Period为Month时，UsedTime取值为整数类型，取值范围为`[1-9]`。
当Period为Year时，UsedTime取值为整数类型，取值范围为`[1-3]`
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: Auto-renewal is enabled.
false: Auto-renewal is disabled.

Default value: false.

This parameter takes effect only when PayType is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动续费，取值范围如下：

true：自动续费。
false：不自动续费。

默认为false。

当参数PayType取值为Prepaid时，该参数才生效
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The acceleration mode. Valid values:

ONLY: enables acceleration only.
ON: enables cold data storage and acceleration
parameters.help_zh:
加速启动，取值范围如下：

ONLY：仅开启加速。
ON：开启冷叔据+加速
parameters.name: accelerate_switch

parameters.help_en: The acceleration storage space for Basic Edition with acceleration enabled. Unit: GB
parameters.help_zh: 加速空间，基础班开启加速，单位GB
parameters.name: accelerate_storage_size

parameters.help_en:
The edition. Valid values:

basic: Basic Edition (default).
cold: Cold Storage Edition.
high_performance: High-performance Edition
parameters.help_zh:
产品系列，取值范围如下：

basic：基础版（默认值）
cold：冷存版
high_performance：高性能版
parameters.name: creation_category

parameters.help_en:
The number of buckets.

Bucket 数量。

仅开启加速（文件系统加速）场景必填

The bucket path.

bucket路径。

仅开启加速（文件系统加速）场景必填
parameters.name: custom_bucket_path

false: Coupons are not used

alluxio：透明加速
